subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Chinese EV Juggernaut
description: One-minute skill: The Chinese EV Juggernaut.

hook.text: China sold more EVs in 2023 than the rest of the world combined—and its dominance is accelerating.

buildup.text: BYD surpassed Tesla in total EV sales, offering models at prices Western brands cannot match.

discovery.text: Years of government subsidies, cheap batteries, and a massive domestic market gave China an unbeatable head start.

twist.text: European and American tariffs are rising to block cheap Chinese EVs, sparking a global trade war over cars.

climax.text: Whether the West competes or protects, China's low-cost EVs are reshaping the global auto industry.

punchline.text: The country that made cheap everything now makes cheap electric cars.

quiz.question: Which company surpassed Tesla in total EV sales?
